title: Rein v2 testing configuration (.rein/policy/testing.yaml)
$comment: REFERENCE ONLY — not loaded at runtime (plan Task 4.3 Steps 2). The single authoritative validator is plugins/rein-core/rein/capabilities/testing/capability.py:parse_testing_config, built on the D3 subset YAML parser (plugins/rein-core/rein/kernel/yaml_subset.py). This JSON Schema exists purely for human readers and editor/IDE autocompletion — it documents the same closed schema the runtime loader enforces (spec §5.2), but the runtime never reads this file.
description: Declares the test commands a project runs, so the tests_passed Evidence eligibility gate (spec §5.2) can recognize a runtime-observed command as declared. File location is fixed at the project-root-relative path `.rein/policy/testing.yaml` (plan D1); this schema documents its shape only, not its path.

commands.description: Declared test commands, evaluated top-to-bottom. A runtime-observed command is eligible for tests_passed only if it matches one entry's `run` exactly, or `run` plus additional trailing arguments (spec §5.2 condition 1).

id.description: Unique identifier for this declared command within the file.

run.description: The declared command string. A runtime-observed command is eligible only if its tokens equal these tokens exactly, or extend them with additional trailing arguments.

tag.description: Which Tag ChangeSet (rein/engine/tags.py TAG_NAMES) this command's tests_passed Evidence is scoped to.
